note: Contributions are indexed from the chain automatically (see /api/register). Use claims only to name transfers sent from exchanges, which cannot sign. Payments out are one entry each. date is the payout date. amount_usd is the figure existing readers display and sum; when amount_sent_usd is set, amount_usd equals it (what the recipient was sent). usdc_received is the USDC that came in on Base for that payout. fee_usd is any fee or other gap, or 0 when there is none. Older entries may omit the three added fields. Proof is the transaction hash (tx) or, for card and bank payments, a public receipt URL (receipt).
